newsitem.title: FRANCE: French 1996 public deficit 4.1 pct of GDP - Arthuis.
newsitem.headline: French 1996 public deficit 4.1 pct of GDP - Arthuis.

text.p: France's total public deficits for 1996 are expected to be limited to 4.1 percent of gross domestic product (GDP), finance minister Jean Arthuis said on Wednesday.
"The local authorities have balanced their budgets and thus, the total public financing requirement should be 4.1 percent...," he said on leaving the weekly cabinet meeting.
"This is good news which augurs well for France's ability to meet its commitments," he added.

The government had set a target of reducing the public deficit to four percent of GDP in 1996 and three percent in 1997, in order to meet the Maastricht criteria for joining the single European currency in 1999.
